limitations.description: Current partner sites are synthetic random clients, not real hospitals or institutions.
Current collaborative training split is synthetic/random/IID-style and not real institution-based.
Collaborative model is a local simulator proof of concept, not a secure provisioned production FLARE deployment.
Collaborative model is a PyTorch MLP while the centralized benchmark is LightGBM; comparisons are directional.
Collaborative model probabilities are not yet calibrated unless a future calibration artifact is supplied.
Rare outcome prevalence causes low precision; accuracy and threshold 0.5 are misleading planning metrics.
No real institution-based validation has been completed yet.
No external validation has been completed yet.
Administrative claims labels may contain coding noise.
Feature importance describes association, not causality.
Version 1 dashboard should expose aggregate data only, not patient-level records.
Privacy-preserving collaboration reduces raw data sharing but does not eliminate all privacy risks.
